title: Comparative Tangkhul Dialect Glossary: Phungcham, Hundung, Champhung, and Ukhrul
creator: Tangkhul Dialect Documentation Project
notes: Field vocabulary comparing everyday agricultural, domestic, and body part terms across four Tangkhul villages. Candidate record flagged for community verification.
background: Initiated in 2018 by independent community researchers and mother-tongue educators as the Tangkhul Dialect Documentation Project (TDDP). Elicits everyday agricultural, domestic, anatomical, and cultural vocabulary across four geographically and historically divergent villages: Phungcham (northern), Hundung (southern valley), Champhung (western archaic variety), and Ukhrul (central standard). Demonstrates significant lexical divergences between varieties.
phonology_notes: Preserves archaic consonants (e.g. initial r/l shifts, consonant clusters, and distinct vowel reflexes) found in Champhung and Phungcham that have merged in standard Ukhrul.
